Key: the rule (E outside, S separation) and the label of the A2 line (icon, mode, size, appearance, scenario, tint, transparency); value: the measured metric of the rule, default: the Default rendering's. docs/specs/ui.md lists the same cells (tests/shell/a2_limits_doc.sh). Values marked PROVISIONAL in ui.md come from the offline model (.dev/a2m, calibrated on the GPU run of 2026-10-23) and are replaced by the next GPU run.
